archetypes.name: shell-streams
archetypes.rationale: The plan defines multiple stream-routing invariants (stderr-only exit-2, stdout-empty on failure, set+e/set-e fences) that are easy to drift in implementation; checks plan completeness and internal consistency of those contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan specifies several interacting stream-routing contracts: exit-2 must produce nothing on stdout and direct operator messages to stderr so they bypass command-substitution capture; `set +e` / `set -e` fences must bracket both wrapper call sites; `IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR` must be exported unchanged on `--mode resume` without re-derivation; the wrapper must never write `session-env.sh` (NEVER #14). Verify each contract is unambiguously specified in the plan without gaps: check whether the plan covers wrapper behavior when `IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR` is absent or empty at `--mode resume` invocation, whether any sub-command stdout could leak into the captured stdout before an exit-2 path (e.g. from `set -x` side effects or sub-command prologue output), and whether all Bash 3.2-incompatible constructs are absent from the plan's inline code snippets. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: pin-inversion
archetypes.rationale: The plan inverts a multi-block pin set in test-implement-structure.sh including the 507-526 range; incomplete or mismatched inversions silently break CI and the plan's described scope may not match the actual current pin layout.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan proposes inverting and retargeting a substantial range of pins in `scripts/test-implement-structure.sh` (pre-507 block and the 507–526 range), asserting each `_ib_*` symbol absent, switching call-site assertions from `implement-bootstrap.sh` to `implement-bootstrap-invoke.sh`, and adding new `set +e` / `set -e` fence assertions. Check whether the plan's description of the 507–526 range accurately reflects the actual current file: specifically whether all `_ib_*` symbols listed (including `_ib_target_issue`, `_ib_rc`, `_ib_kv_scan`) appear in both `skills/implement/SKILL.md` and the test file today, and whether the plan omits any currently-present pins that would need inversion but are not mentioned. Also verify whether the new `skills/implement/scripts/test-implement-bootstrap-invoke.sh` harness coverage accounts for all `STEP_FAILED` case arms named in `scripts/implement-bootstrap.sh` (`session-entry-gate`, `session-setup`, `get-issue-state`, `issue-number-required-for-resume`, `copy-plan`, `gh-issue-view`, `resume-plan-tail-sentinel`). Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
